name: Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)
description: Windsurf is the AI-native code editor now rebranded by Cognition as Devin Desktop. The current product keeps the Windsurf IDE foundation while adding an agent command center for managing multiple coding agents, alongside Cascade agent workflows, editor tooling, extensions, and MCP integrations.
best_for: Developers and engineering teams that want an AI-first desktop coding environment with agentic code changes and a command center for coordinating multiple software-development agents.
features: Full Windsurf IDE experience retained under the Devin Desktop name
Agent Command Center with Spaces, Kanban-style organization, and multi-agent management
Cascade agent with Code, Plan, and Ask modes for code changes, planning, questions, and tool use
Tool calling, checkpoints, linter integration, web search, memories, and rules within Cascade
Extension ecosystem and language-server support inherited from the editor workflow
MCP server integrations for external tools and services
Over-the-air migration from Windsurf with existing plans, pricing, extensions, settings, and in-progress work preserved

tiers.name: Teams
tiers.notes: $80/month base plus $40/month per full seat, per the current Devin Desktop/Windsurf product page.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales for enterprise requirements and legacy Windsurf Enterprise arrangements.

pros: Current pricing page retains a permanent free plan plus published individual and team pricing
Windsurf users migrate to Devin Desktop without losing editor settings, extensions, plan, or pricing
Agent workflows sit inside a full desktop IDE rather than a browser-only app builder
cons: The Windsurf name is being replaced by Devin Desktop, which can create product-name confusion during the transition
Teams pricing combines a base subscription and per-full-seat charge rather than a simple flat per-seat rate
The product is aimed at code-centric workflows and is less suitable for nontechnical users wanting pure prompt-to-app building

faq.question: Is Windsurf still available?
faq.answer: Windsurf has been renamed Devin Desktop. Cognition states that Devin Desktop arrives as an over-the-air update and preserves the Windsurf IDE, extensions, settings, plans, pricing, and in-progress work.

faq.question: How much does Windsurf / Devin Desktop cost?
faq.answer: The current official product page lists Free at $0, Pro at $20/month, Max at $200/month, Teams at $80/month plus $40/month per full seat, and Enterprise via sales.
